require 'yaml'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'digest'
require 'logger'

module ConfigStore
  LOGGER = Logger.new($stdout)
  LOGGER.level = Logger::WARN

  class ValidationError < StandardError; end
  class AccessDenied < StandardError; end

  # Secure token generation and verification
  class TokenManager
    HMAC_KEY = ENV.fetch('HMAC_SECRET') { SecureRandom.hex(32) }.freeze
    TOKEN_TTL = 3600

    def self.generate(user_id)
      expires = Time.now.to_i + TOKEN_TTL
      payload = "#{user_id}:#{expires}"
      sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_KEY, payload)
      Base64.urlsafe_encode64("#{payload}:#{sig}")
    end

    def self.verify(token)
      decoded = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(token)
      parts = decoded.split(':')
      return nil unless parts.length == 3
      user_id, expires, sig = parts
      payload = "#{user_id}:#{expires}"
      expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_KEY, payload)
      return nil unless Rack::Utils.secure_compare(sig, expected)
      return nil if Time.now.to_i > expires.to_i
      user_id
    end
  end

  # Configuration object that supports serialization
  class ConfigEntry
    attr_accessor :key, :value, :metadata, :transform

    def initialize(key:, value:, metadata: {}, transform: nil)
      @key = key.to_s
      @value = value
      @metadata = metadata
      @transform = transform
    end

    def resolved_value
      if @transform
        apply_transform(@value, @transform)
      else
        @value
      end
    end

    private

    def apply_transform(val, transform_spec)
      method_name = transform_spec[:method]
      args = transform_spec[:args] || []
      # Only allow safe string transforms
      safe_methods = %w[upcase downcase strip reverse capitalize swapcase]
      unless safe_methods.include?(method_name.to_s)
        raise ValidationError, "Unsafe transform: #{method_name}"
      end
      val.to_s.public_send(method_name, *args)
    end
  end

  # Main configuration store with YAML persistence
  class Store
    PERMITTED_YAML_CLASSES = [Symbol, Date, Time, Regexp, ConfigEntry].freeze
    MAX_CONFIG_SIZE = 65536
    SAFE_KEY_PATTERN = /\A[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_\.]{0,127}\z/

    def initialize(storage_dir:)
      @storage_dir = File.expand_path(storage_dir)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@storage_dir)
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @cache = {}
    end

    # Load config from YAML with safe deserialization
    def load_config(namespace)
      validate_namespace!(namespace)
      path = config_path(namespace)
      return {} unless File.exist?(path)

      content = File.read(path, encoding: 'UTF-8')
      if content.bytesize > MAX_CONFIG_SIZE
        raise ValidationError, "Config too large"
      end

      data = YAML.safe_load(
        content,
        permitted_classes: PERMITTED_YAML_CLASSES,
        permitted_symbols: [],
        aliases: true
      )

      return {} unless data.is_a?(Hash)
      @mutex.synchronize { @cache[namespace] = data }
      data
    end

    # Save config entries
    def save_config(namespace, entries)
      validate_namespace!(namespace)
      validated = validate_entries(entries)
      path = config_path(namespace)

      yaml_content = YAML.dump(validated)
      if yaml_content.bytesize > MAX_CONFIG_SIZE
        raise ValidationError, "Serialized config too large"
      end

      @mutex.synchronize do
        File.write(path, yaml_content)
        @cache[namespace] = validated
      end
      true
    end

    # Merge user-provided YAML into existing config
    def merge_yaml(namespace, yaml_string)
      validate_namespace!(namespace)
      if yaml_string.bytesize > MAX_CONFIG_SIZE
        raise ValidationError, "Input too large"
      end

      user_data = YAML.safe_load(
        yaml_string,
        permitted_classes: PERMITTED_YAML_CLASSES,
        permitted_symbols: [],
        aliases: true
      )

      unless user_data.is_a?(Hash)
        raise ValidationError, "Expected mapping at top level"
      end

      existing = load_config(namespace)
      merged = deep_merge(existing, user_data)
      save_config(namespace, merged)
      merged
    end

    # Retrieve a config value by dotted path
    def get(namespace, dotted_key)
      validate_namespace!(namespace)
      data = @cache[namespace] || load_config(namespace)
      resolve_dotted(data, dotted_key)
    end

    # Batch operation: apply a series of operations
    def batch_apply(namespace, operations)
      validate_namespace!(namespace)
      data = load_config(namespace)

      operations.each do |op|
        case op[:action].to_s
        when 'set'
          data = set_nested(data, op[:path], op[:value])
        when 'delete'
          data = delete_nested(data, op[:path])
        when 'transform'
          data = transform_nested(data, op[:path], op[:transform])
        else
          raise ValidationError, "Unknown action: #{op[:action]}"
        end
      end

      save_config(namespace, data)
      data
    end

    private

    def config_path(namespace)
      File.join(@storage_dir, "#{namespace}.yml")
    end

    def validate_namespace!(ns)
      unless ns.to_s.match?(SAFE_KEY_PATTERN)
        raise ValidationError, "Invalid namespace: #{ns}"
      end
    end

    def validate_entries(entries)
      case entries
      when Hash
        entries.each_with_object({}) do |(k, v), acc|
          unless k.to_s.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+\z/)
            raise ValidationError, "Invalid key: #{k}"
          end
          acc[k.to_s] = validate_entries(v)
        end
      when Array
        entries.map { |e| validate_entries(e) }
      when String, Integer, Float, TrueClass, FalseClass, NilClass
        entries
      when Symbol
        entries
      when ConfigEntry
        entries
      else
        raise ValidationError, "Unsupported type: #{entries.class}"
      end
    end

    def deep_merge(base, overlay)
      base.merge(overlay) do |_key, old_val, new_val|
        if old_val.is_a?(Hash) && new_val.is_a?(Hash)
          deep_merge(old_val, new_val)
        else
          new_val
        end
      end
    end

    def resolve_dotted(data, dotted_key)
      keys = dotted_key.to_s.split('.')
      keys.reduce(data) do |current, key|
        case current
        when Hash
          current[key] || current[key.to_sym]
        when Array
          current[Integer(key)]
        else
          nil
        end
      end
    end

    def set_nested(data, path, value)
      keys = path.to_s.split('.')
      return data if keys.empty?
      if keys.length == 1
        data.merge(keys.first => value)
      else
        key = keys.first
        child = data[key] || {}
        data.merge(key => set_nested(child, keys[1..].join('.'), value))
      end
    end

    def delete_nested(data, path)
      keys = path.to_s.split('.')
      return data if keys.empty?
      if keys.length == 1
        data.reject { |k, _| k == keys.first }
      else
        key = keys.first
        child = data[key]
        return data unless child.is_a?(Hash)
        data.merge(key => delete_nested(child, keys[1..].join('.')))
      end
    end

    def transform_nested(data, path, transform_spec)
      keys = path.to_s.split('.')
      return data if keys.empty?
      if keys.length == 1
        val = data[keys.first]
        entry = ConfigEntry.new(key: keys.first, value: val, transform: transform_spec)
        data.merge(keys.first => entry.resolved_value)
      else
        key = keys.first
        child = data[key]
        return data unless child.is_a?(Hash)
        data.merge(key => transform_nested(child, keys[1..].join('.'), transform_spec))
      end
    end
  end

  # HTTP handler for the config service
  class Handler
    def initialize(storage_dir: '/tmp/config_store')
      @store = Store.new(storage_dir: storage_dir)
    end

    def handle(request)
      case request[:method]
      when 'GET'
        handle_get(request)
      when 'PUT'
        handle_put(request)
      when 'POST'
        handle_post(request)
      when 'PATCH'
        handle_patch(request)
      else
        { status: 405, body: 'Method not allowed' }
      end
    rescue AccessDenied => e
      { status: 403, body: e.message }
    rescue ValidationError => e
      { status: 400, body: e.message }
    rescue => e
      LOGGER.error("Unhandled: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      { status: 500, body: 'Internal error' }
    end

    private

    def handle_get(request)
      ns = request[:params][:namespace]
      key = request[:params][:key]
      value = @store.get(ns, key)
      { status: 200, body: JSON.generate({ value: value }) }
    end

    def handle_put(request)
      ns = request[:params][:namespace]
      entries = JSON.parse(request[:body], symbolize_names: false)
      @store.save_config(ns, entries)
      { status: 200, body: JSON.generate({ success: true }) }
    end

    def handle_post(request)
      ns = request[:params][:namespace]
      yaml_body = request[:body]
      result = @store.merge_yaml(ns, yaml_body)
      { status: 200, body: JSON.generate({ merged: result }) }
    end

    def handle_patch(request)
      ns = request[:params][:namespace]
      ops = JSON.parse(request[:body], symbolize_names: true)
      result = @store.batch_apply(ns, ops)
      { status: 200, body: JSON.generate({ result: result }) }
    end
  end
end
